name: agent-sidebar
description: A side pane listing background agents, colored by model, with live activity and token use; click a row to view that agent. The header shows how much of the main context window is used, and an opt-in context watch (/hr-watch, /hr-off) asks for a handoff at a threshold, in nudge or auto mode. The model gets three tools: agents (the roster as JSON), hr_watch and hr_off (arm and disarm the watch).
